name: Brittany Nyman
occupation: Carbon County coroner (serving through the current term, which ends in January 2027)
prior_offices: Carbon County coroner (won the November 2022 general election; lost the August 2026 Republican primary)
background: Brittany Nyman is the Carbon County coroner, serving through the end of the current term in January 2027. She won the November 2022 general election and lost the August 2026 Republican primary. Incoming coroner Shayna Casada takes office in January 2027.
